# Operation reference

<!-- Generated by `pointcloudlabeler ops docs` from the operation catalogue (src-tauri/src/ops). Do not edit; regenerate. -->

Every operation PointCloudLabeler can run without its window, as the command line, the console interface, the HTTP API and the MCP server offer it. The same operations drive the desktop application's panels; the defaults are the panels' defaults.

| Surface | How an operation is named |
| --- | --- |
| Command line | `pointcloudlabeler <group> <name>`, parameters as `--kebab-case` flags, or `pointcloudlabeler ops run <group.name> --params '{…}'` |
| HTTP API | `POST /api/ops/<group.name>` with the parameters as the JSON body |
| MCP | the tool `<group>_<name>` with the parameters as its arguments |
| Recipe | `{"op": "<group.name>", "params": {…}}` |

Parameter names are the wire names (camelCase) the desktop application uses too. A parameter marked *required* has no default. *Writes* means the operation changes the dataset or project it names; *stage* is what `run cancel` takes to stop it.

## project

### `project.create`

Create a project folder (project.json, clouds/) and open it.

writes · command line `pointcloudlabeler project create` · MCP tool `project_create`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder` | string | *required* | Folder to create the project in (made if missing; must not already hold one). |
| `name` | string | *required* | The name of the thing created. |
| `crsName` | string, nullable | `null` | Name of the coordinate reference system (default "unknown"). |
| `epsg` | integer, nullable | `null` | EPSG code of the project's coordinate reference system, if known. |
| `notes` | string, nullable | `null` | Free-text notes stored in project.json. |

### `project.open`

Open a project folder; it becomes the default for operations that take a projectFolder.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler project open` · MCP tool `project_open`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder` | string | *required* | A folder holding project.json. |

### `project.current`

The open project, or null.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler project current` · MCP tool `project_current`.

No parameters.

### `project.close`

Close the open project.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler project close` · MCP tool `project_close`.

No parameters.

### `project.recent`

Recently opened projects, newest first, each checked for still existing.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler project recent` · MCP tool `project_recent`.

No parameters.

### `project.datasets`

The datasets under a project's octrees/ folder.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler project datasets` · MCP tool `project_datasets`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectFolder` | string, nullable | `null` | The project folder. Defaults to the open project. |

## dataset

### `dataset.probe`

What a text, PLY or E57 point file has: its columns, the first rows, and the column mapping an import would guess.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler dataset probe` · MCP tool `dataset_probe`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | *required* | A text, PLY or E57 point file. |

### `dataset.import`

Convert a LAS/LAZ, text (.txt/.xyz/.csv), PLY or E57 file into an octree dataset, on the file's own coordinate grid.

writes · stage `import` · command line `pointcloudlabeler dataset import` · MCP tool `dataset_import`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcPath` | string | *required* | The LAS or LAZ file to import. |
| `extraNames` | JSON | `[]` | Columns to carry into the dataset: Extra Bytes dimensions by name, and the standard fields of the LAS record under their reserved names (gps_time, red, green, blue, nir, point_source_id, scan_angle, user_data, scan_direction, edge_of_flight_line, synthetic, key_point, withheld, overlap, scanner_channel), each where the point format carries it. |
| `includeDeadwood` | boolean | `false` | Add the two deadwood columns even when no source dimension fills them. |
| `layingDeadwoodExtraName` | string, nullable | `null` | LAS Extra Bytes dimension to read as the lying-deadwood id. |
| `mapping` | JSON, nullable | `null` | A text (.txt/.xyz/.csv/.asc/.pts), PLY or E57 file: which of its columns fills which field — x, y, z, intensity, red, green, blue, classification, gpsTime, treeId, semantic, returnNumber, numberOfReturns, pointSourceId, scanAngle, userData, nir, standingDeadwood, layingDeadwood, and `extras`, the columns carried under their own names. Column names as `dataset.probe` lists them; omitted, the probe's guess by name. Ignored for LAS/LAZ. |
| `maxDepth` | integer | `14` | Octree depth limit (default 14). |
| `name` | string, nullable | `null` | Dataset name. Defaults to the file name without its extension. |
| `outDir` | string, nullable | `null` | Where the dataset directory goes. Defaults to `<projectFolder>/octrees/<safe name>`, as the Editor's import does. |
| `projectFolder` | string, nullable | `null` | The project folder, when `outDir` is not given. Defaults to the open project. |
| `rootSpacing` | number | `0.0` | Root node spacing in metres; 0 (the default) lets the converter choose. |
| `scannerType` | string | `other` | "tls", "mls", "als", "uls" or "other" (default "other"), as the import dialog offers. |
| `semanticExtraName` | string, nullable | `null` | LAS Extra Bytes dimension to read as the stem/branch label. |
| `standingDeadwoodExtraName` | string, nullable | `null` | LAS Extra Bytes dimension to read as the standing-deadwood id. |
| `treeIdExtraName` | string, nullable | `null` | LAS Extra Bytes dimension to read as the tree id. |

### `dataset.clean`

Remove outliers (statistical or radius) into a new dataset.

writes · stage `clean` · command line `pointcloudlabeler dataset clean` · MCP tool `dataset_clean`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | *required* | The new dataset's name. |
| `srcDir` | string | *required* | The dataset to read from. |
| `k` | integer, nullable | `null` | Neighbours for "sor" (default 8). |
| `method` | string | `sor` | "sor" (statistical, k neighbours and a standard-deviation multiplier) or "radius" (a radius and a neighbour count). |
| `minNeighbours` | integer, nullable | `null` | Neighbours a point needs within the radius (default 2). |
| `outDir` | string, nullable | `null` | Defaults to `<octrees>/<safe name>` beside the source. |
| `radius` | number, nullable | `null` | Search radius for "radius", metres (default 0.05). |
| `scannerType` | string | `other` | "tls", "mls", "als", "uls" or "other". |
| `stdMult` | number, nullable | `null` | Standard-deviation multiplier for "sor" (default 1.0). |

### `preprocess.projects`

The scanner projects imported into a project folder, by importer, with their scan positions.

### `preprocess.solve`

Solve the rigid correction over at least three tie points (Kabsch); optionally compose it onto a scan's pose.

writes · command line `pointcloudlabeler preprocess solve` · MCP tool `preprocess_solve`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ties` | JSON | *required* | At least three tie points, in world coordinates. |
| `applyTo` | JSON, nullable | `null` | Apply the correction to this scan's pose (composed onto its current one). |
| `projectFolder` | string, nullable | `null` | The project folder; defaults to the open project. |

### `preprocess.apply`

Write a pose to a scan position: an absolute pose, or a correction composed onto the current one.

writes · command line `pointcloudlabeler preprocess apply` · MCP tool `preprocess_apply`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pose` | JSON | *required* | The 4×4 pose, row-major, 16 numbers. |
| `scan` | JSON | *required* |  |
| `delta` | boolean | `false` | Compose onto the scan's current pose (a correction) rather than replace it (default false). |
| `projectFolder` | string, nullable | `null` | The project folder; defaults to the open project. |

### `preprocess.icp`

ICP fine refinement of a source scan against a target (point-to-point or point-to-plane); optionally write the refined pose.

writes · command line `pointcloudlabeler preprocess icp` · MCP tool `preprocess_icp`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | JSON | *required* |  |
| `target` | JSON | *required* |  |
| `apply` | boolean | `false` | Write the refined pose to the source scan (default false). |
| `maxCorrDist` | number | `0.5` | Correspondence distance cap, metres (default 0.5). |
| `maxIters` | integer | `30` | Iterations at most (default 30). |
| `method` | string | `pointToPoint` | "pointToPoint" (Besl & McKay 1992) or "pointToPlane" (Chen & Medioni 1991). |
| `normalK` | integer | `12` | Neighbours for the point-to-plane normals (default 12). |
| `projectFolder` | string, nullable | `null` | The project folder; defaults to the open project. |
| `samplePoints` | integer | `60000` | Points sampled from each scan (default 60000). |

### `preprocess.targets`

Detect sphere targets and plane patches in one scan position's points.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler preprocess targets` · MCP tool `preprocess_targets`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scan` | JSON | *required* |  |
| `planes` | JSON | — | Plane extraction settings (defaults when omitted). |
| `projectFolder` | string, nullable | `null` | The project folder; defaults to the open project. |
| `spheres` | JSON | — | Sphere detection settings (defaults when omitted). |
| `withPlanes` | boolean | `true` | Also extract plane patches (default true). |

### `preprocess.matchSpheres`

Detect spheres in two scans, pair them by RANSAC and solve the correction over the pairs; optionally apply it to the source.

writes · command line `pointcloudlabeler preprocess match-spheres` · MCP tool `preprocess_match_spheres`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | JSON | *required* |  |
| `target` | JSON | *required* |  |
| `apply` | boolean | `false` | Apply the Kabsch correction over the matched spheres to the source scan (default false). |
| `projectFolder` | string, nullable | `null` | The project folder; defaults to the open project. |
| `spheres` | JSON | — | Sphere detection and matching settings (defaults when omitted). |

### `preprocess.msa`

Multi-station adjustment over every E57 / PTX scan: sphere and plane correspondences for every pair, one least-squares fit; optionally write the adjusted poses.

writes · command line `pointcloudlabeler preprocess msa` · MCP tool `preprocess_msa`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apply` | boolean | `false` | Write the adjusted poses to the manifests (default false). |
| `lambdaInit` | number | `0.0001` | Levenberg–Marquardt damping to start from (default 1e-4). |
| `maxIters` | integer | `1000` | Iterations at most (default 1000, the vendor's lsqFitter.maxIterations). |
| `planes` | JSON | — | Plane extraction and matching settings (defaults when omitted). |
| `preserveRollPitch` | boolean | `true` | Keep each scan's roll and pitch, adjusting yaw and position only (default true, the vendor's lsqFitterPlanes.preserveRollAndPitch). |
| `projectFolder` | string, nullable | `null` | The project folder; defaults to the open project. |
| `rmseEps` | number | `1e-6` | Stop when the RMSE improves by less than this, metres (default 1e-6, the vendor's lsqFitter.tolerance). |
| `scans` | JSON, nullable | `null` | The scans to adjust; null takes every E57 and PTX scan position of the project. |
| `spheres` | JSON | — | Sphere detection and matching settings (defaults when omitted). |
| `withPlanes` | boolean | `true` | Also use plane correspondences (default true). |

## ground

### `ground.classify`

Classify ground points (class 2) with the progressive morphological or the cloth simulation filter.

writes · stage `classify_ground` · command line `pointcloudlabeler ground classify` · MCP tool `ground_classify`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `cellSize` | number | `0.5` | Raster cell size, metres. |
| `initialThreshold` | number | `0.3` | Initial elevation threshold, metres (pmf). |
| `maxThreshold` | number | `2.5` | Largest elevation threshold, metres (pmf). |
| `maxWindowM` | number | `20.0` | Largest filter window, metres (pmf). |
| `method` | string | `pmf` | "pmf" (progressive morphological filter, Zhang et al. 2003) or "csf" (cloth simulation, Zhang et al. 2016). |
| `rigidity` | number | `2.0` | Cloth rigidity (csf only). |
| `slope` | number | `0.2` | Terrain slope allowance (pmf). |
| `tolerance` | number | `0.2` | Ground tolerance, metres (pmf). |

### `ground.reset`

Rewrite the classification of every point of one class (or of all points).

writes · stage `reset_class` · command line `pointcloudlabeler ground reset` · MCP tool `ground_reset`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fromClass` | integer | *required* | The class to reset; -1 for every point. |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `toClass` | integer | `1` | The class to set (default 1, "unclassified"). |

### `ground.terrain`

Write the DTM, DSM, CHM and the terrain derivatives into the dataset's terrain/ folder.

writes · stage `terrain` · command line `pointcloudlabeler ground terrain` · MCP tool `ground_terrain`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `cellSize` | number | `0.5` | Raster cell size, metres. |

| `epsg` | integer, nullable | `null` | EPSG code written into the GeoTIFFs; defaults to the dataset's recorded CRS. |
| `hillshadeAltitudeDeg` | number | `45.0` | Sun altitude for the hillshade, degrees. |
| `hillshadeAzimuthDeg` | number | `315.0` | Sun azimuth for the hillshade, degrees. |
| `hliLatitudeDeg` | number | `60.0` | Latitude for the heat-load index (default 60). |
| `streamFraction` | number | `0.01` | Flow-accumulation fraction that starts a stream (default 0.01). |

## segment

### `segment.chm`

Segment trees by watershed over the canopy height model; writes tree ids and clears their overlay overrides.

writes · stage `segment` · command line `pointcloudlabeler segment chm` · MCP tool `segment_chm`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `cellSize` | number | `0.5` | Raster cell size, metres. |
| `crownBaseRadius` | number | `1.5` | Crown radius at zero height, metres. |
| `crownMaxRadius` | number | `5.0` | Largest crown radius, metres. |
| `crownRadiusPerM` | number | `0.05` | Crown radius growth per metre of tree height. |
| `minHeight` | number | `2.0` | Trees shorter than this are not seeded (default 2 m). |
| `smooth` | number | `1.0` | Gaussian smoothing of the CHM, in cells (default 1). |

### `segment.treeiso`

Segment trees with treeiso (cut-pursuit on a voxel graph); writes tree ids.

writes · stage `treeiso` · command line `pointcloudlabeler segment treeiso` · MCP tool `segment_treeiso`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `decimate2` | number | `0.1` | Decimation fraction before the second cut. |
| `k1` | integer | `5` | Neighbours in the first (local) cut (treeiso k1). |
| `k2` | integer | `20` | Neighbours in the second (global) cut. |
| `k3` | integer | `20` | Neighbours in the final merge. |
| `lambda1` | number | `1.0` | Regularisation strength of the first cut. |
| `lambda2` | number | `20.0` | Regularisation strength of the second cut. |
| `maxGap` | number | `2.0` | Largest gap bridged between segments, metres. |
| `minTreePts` | integer | `20` | Segments with fewer points are not trees. |
| `rho` | number | `0.5` | Relative height weight in the final merge. |
| `verticalWeight` | number | `0.5` | Weight of the vertical axis in the final merge. |
| `voxelSize` | number | `0.1` | Voxel size, metres. |

## metrics

### `metrics.trees`

Per-tree height, DBH, basal area, crown area and diameter, position and lean, with RANSAC stem fits merged in.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics trees` · MCP tool `metrics_trees`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with the RANSAC stem fit from stems.json where one exists (default true). |

### `metrics.stems`

Fit RANSAC stem circles in the stem band and save them to stems.json.

writes · stage `stemfit` · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics stems` · MCP tool `metrics_stems`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `bandHigh` | number | `3.0` | Stem band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bandLow` | number | `1.0` | Stem band, metres above ground (default 1.0 to 3.0). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `inlierTol` | number | `0.03` | Inlier tolerance, metres (default 0.03). |
| `iterations` | integer | `600` | RANSAC iterations per tree. |
| `minInliers` | integer | `12` | Fewest inliers for a fit to count. |
| `writeSemantic` | boolean | `false` | Also label the fitted band's inliers as stem in octree.bin (default false). |

### `metrics.qsm`

Fit the sliced stem model per tree (volume with uncertainty, taper) and save qsm.json.

writes · stage `qsm` · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics qsm` · MCP tool `metrics_qsm`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `branchMethod` | string | `simple` | "simple" or "treeqsm". |
| `branchVoxel` | number | `0.1` | Voxel size for the branch fit, metres. |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `enableBranches` | boolean | `false` | Also fit branch cylinders. |
| `minPointsPerSlice` | integer | `15` | Fewest points a slice needs to be fitted. |
| `minTreeHeight` | number | `3.0` | Trees shorter than this get no stem model, metres. |
| `sliceHeight` | number | `0.25` | Slice height, metres. |

### `metrics.summary`

Per-tree point counts, bounds and centroids from the complete edited dataset.

read-only · stage `tree_summary` · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics summary` · MCP tool `metrics_summary`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `withRecords` | boolean | `false` | Include each tree's node record list (large; the viewer uses it, a table does not). |

### `metrics.density`

Gridded canopy density metrics written to the dataset's density/ folder.

writes · stage `density` · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics density` · MCP tool `metrics_density`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `canopyThreshold` | number | `2.0` | Height above ground where the canopy begins, metres. |
| `cellSize` | number | `2.0` | Raster cell size, metres. |
| `epsg` | integer, nullable | `null` | EPSG code written into the rasters; defaults to the dataset's recorded CRS. |
| `minHeight` | number | `0.2` | Trees shorter than this are not seeded, metres. |

## qc

### `qc.flags`

Run the ten per-tree checks over the metrics and the QSM cache; flags ranked by severity.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler qc flags` · MCP tool `qc_flags`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, lower bound above ground, metres. |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres. |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `withBoxes` | boolean | `false` | Attach each tree's bounds to its flags (one more pass over the cloud). |
| `withMetrics` | boolean | `false` | Also return the merged per-tree metrics the flags were judged on. |

## metrics

### `metrics.volumes`

Stem volume per tree: the QSM where measured, else Laasasenaho 1982 by species, else a form factor; with the source of each.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics volumes` · MCP tool `metrics_volumes`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `defaultSpecies` | string, nullable | `pine` | Species function for trees with no entry in species.json: "pine", "spruce" or "birch" (Finnish names accepted); null leaves them to the form factor (default "pine"). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `formFactor` | number | `0.5` | Form factor for the last resort, V = g · h · f (default 0.50). |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with the RANSAC stem fit from stems.json where one exists (default true). |
| `useQsm` | boolean | `true` | Prefer the measured QSM stem volume from qsm.json where one exists (default true). |

### `metrics.biomass`

Biomass, carbon and CO₂e per tree and for the plot from qsm.json, each tree at its species' wood density, with 1σ uncertainties.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics biomass` · MCP tool `metrics_biomass`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `branchUncFraction` | number | `0.25` | Relative 1σ uncertainty on branch volume, every tree (default 0.25). |
| `carbonFraction` | number | `0.5` | Carbon fraction for the custom fallback (default 0.50). |
| `carbonFractionStd` | number | `0.02` | 1σ carbon-fraction uncertainty, every tree (default 0.02). |
| `density` | number | `400.0` | Wood basic density for the custom fallback, kg/m³ (default 400; a preset overrides it). |
| `densityStd` | number | `25.0` | 1σ density uncertainty for the custom fallback, kg/m³ (default 25). |
| `fallbackSpecies` | string | `pine` | Density preset for trees with no entry in species.json: "pine", "spruce", "birch", "aspen", "oak", or "custom" to use the density given here (default "pine"). |

### `metrics.plot`

Per-hectare statistics inside the plot boundary with edge correction: stems, basal area, Lorey's height, QSM volume.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics plot` · MCP tool `metrics_plot`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `boundary` | JSON, nullable | `null` | A boundary to use instead of the dataset's plot.json: `{"kind":"circular","center":[x,y],"radius":r}` or `{"kind":"rectangular","min":[x,y],"max":[x,y]}`. |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `edge` | string | `crownArea` | Edge correction: "none", "halfcount" or "crownArea" (default "crownArea"). One of: `none`, `halfcount`, `crownArea`. |
| `fit` | string, nullable | — | When no boundary is given or recorded, fit one to the stems: "rectangular" (their bounding box) or "circular" (reaching the farthest stem). One of: `rectangular`, `circular`. |
| `fitMargin` | number | `0.0` | Shrink a fitted boundary by this many metres on each side (default 0). |
| `halfcountBuffer` | number | `1.0` | Width of the half-count band inside the boundary, metres (default 1.0). |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with the RANSAC stem fit from stems.json where one exists (default true). |
| `useQsm` | boolean | `true` | Carry the QSM stem volumes from qsm.json into m³/ha where present (default true). |

### `metrics.thinning`

Simulate a thinning to a target basal area: strip roads, forced corridor removal, boom-reach candidates scored by strategy; the removed list, optionally as CSV.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics thinning` · MCP tool `metrics_thinning`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `boomReach` | number | `10.0` | Harvester boom reach from a centreline, metres (default 10). |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `currency` | string | `€` | Currency symbol or code the price and revenue are in (default "€"). |
| `defaultSpecies` | string, nullable | `pine` | Species function for trees with no entry in species.json ("pine", "spruce", "birch"); null leaves them to the form factor (default "pine"). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `headingDeg` | number | `0.0` | Strip-road heading, degrees from +x (default 0). |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with the RANSAC stem fit from stems.json where one exists (default true). |
| `outCsv` | string, nullable | `null` | Write the removed trees as CSV here (the panel's "Export removed CSV"). |
| `plotAreaHa` | number, nullable | `null` | Plot area in hectares; null takes the recorded plot boundary's area, or the stems' bounding box when there is none. |
| `pricePerM3` | number | `35.0` | Uniform price per m³ for the revenue estimate (default 35). |
| `roadSpacing` | number | `20.0` | Distance between strip-road centrelines, metres (default 20). |
| `roadWidth` | number | `4.0` | Strip-road width; everything within half of it is removed, metres (default 4). |
| `strategy` | string | `low` | Which trees go first: "low", "high", "quality" or "mixed" (default "low"). One of: `low`, `high`, `quality`, `mixed`. |
| `targetBaPerHa` | number | `18.0` | Post-thinning basal area to leave, m²/ha (default 18). |
| `useQsm` | boolean | `true` | Take stem volumes and QSM confidence from qsm.json where present (default true). |
| `withBoxes` | boolean | `false` | Carry each tree's bounding box into the removed list (reads the tree summary; default false). |

### `metrics.bucking`

Buck every QSM stem into log assortments from the stump up (greedy, priority order, longest module first); volumes and revenue per class, per tree and for the plot; optionally as CSV.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler metrics bucking` · MCP tool `metrics_bucking`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `assortments` | JSON, nullable | `null` | Assortments in priority order, each `{"id","name","minTopDcm","lengths":[m…],"pricePerM3"}`; null for the panel's sawlog / pulpwood / energy defaults. |
| `currency` | string | `€` | Currency symbol or code the prices and revenues are in (default "€"). |
| `outCsv` | string, nullable | `null` | Write the per-tree table as CSV here (the panel's "Export CSV"). |
| `stumpHeight` | number | `0.1` | Stump height, metres above ground; nothing below it is cut (default 0.10). |

## qc

### `qc.validate`

Validate the measured trees against a field CSV: match by position, then bias, RMSE and the fit of DBH and height against the caliper and hypsometer.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler qc validate` · MCP tool `qc_validate`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fieldCsv` | string | *required* | The field crew's CSV: id, x, y, caliper DBH (cm), height (m); delimiter, header and decimal comma are detected. |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `dbhCol` | integer, nullable | `null` | Column of the caliper DBH (0-based) when the header is not recognised; null auto-maps. |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `heightCol` | integer, nullable | `null` | Column of the height (0-based) when the header is not recognised. |
| `idCol` | integer, nullable | `null` | Column of the field id. |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with the RANSAC stem fit from stems.json where one exists (default true). |
| `outCsv` | string, nullable | `null` | Write the matched pairs and the unmatched field rows as CSV here (the panel's "Export CSV"). |
| `searchRadius` | number | `2.0` | Match radius around each field position, metres (default 2.0). |
| `xCol` | integer, nullable | `null` | Column of X. |
| `yCol` | integer, nullable | `null` | Column of Y. |

## transfer

### `transfer.buildSkeletons`

Fit a TreeQSM per tree of the baseline and save the skeletons (tree id, branch order) to skeletons.bin.

writes · stage `tst` · command line `pointcloudlabeler transfer build-skeletons` · MCP tool `transfer_build_skeletons`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baselineDir` | string | *required* | The segmented, corrected baseline dataset. |
| `dropFarFragments` | boolean | `true` | Drop skeleton fragments far from the tree (default true). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `groundThreshold` | number | `0.0` | Points below this height above ground are left out (default 0). |
| `maxTreePoints` | integer | `0` | Trees with more points are thinned to this many (default 0: no cap). |
| `minTreePoints` | integer | `0` | Trees with fewer points are skipped (default 0: none skipped). |
| `qsmModels` | integer | `1` | QSM models fitted per tree, the best kept (default 1, up to 8). |
| `rCover` | number | `0.08` | Cover-set radius for the QSM, metres (default 0.08). |
| `skeletonSpacing` | number | `0.02` | Centreline sampling interval, metres (default 0.02). |
| `skipAddedCylinders` | boolean | `true` | Leave out cylinders TreeQSM added without point support (default true). |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Write the skeletons as CSV, TXT, PLY, LAS or LAZ, whole or one file per tree.

read-only · command line `pointcloudlabeler transfer export-skeletons` · MCP tool `transfer_export_skeletons`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `onlyTreeId` | integer, nullable | `null` | Export only this tree. |
| `perTree` | boolean | `false` | One file per tree into `outPath` as a directory. |

### `transfer.run`

Transfer the baseline's tree identities and stem/branch labels into another acquisition of the plot.

writes · stage `tst` · command line `pointcloudlabeler transfer run` · MCP tool `transfer_run`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baselineDir` | string | *required* | The segmented, corrected baseline (its skeletons.bin is built if missing). |
| `targetDir` | string | *required* | The acquisition to label. |
| `alignment` | JSON, nullable | `null` | A horizontal rigid alignment to apply during matching; by default the one `align.measure` stored for the target, if any. |
| `baselineGroundThreshold` | number | `0.0` | The same, when building the baseline's skeletons (default 0). |
| `baselineHeight` | string | `stored` | Which z the baseline is matched in: "stored" or "above_ground". |
| `distanceThreshold` | number | `0.3` | Points within this distance of a skeleton sample take its tree id, metres (default 0.30). |
| `dropFarFragments` | boolean | `true` | Drop skeleton fragments far from the tree. |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `groundThreshold` | number | `0.2` | Target points below this height above ground are left unlabelled (default 0.20). |
| `ignoreStoredAlignment` | boolean | `false` | Ignore a stored alignment (default false). |
| `labelBeyondThreshold` | boolean | `true` | Points slightly beyond the threshold but within reach take the tree id as "not wood" (default true). |
| `maxTreePoints` | integer | `0` | Trees with more points are thinned to this many (0: no cap). |
| `minTreePoints` | integer | `0` | Trees with fewer points are skipped (0: none skipped). |
| `qsmModels` | integer | `1` | QSM models fitted per tree, the best kept (1 to 8). |
| `rCover` | number | `0.08` | Cover-set radius for the QSM, metres. |
| `skeletonSpacing` | number | `0.02` | Centreline sampling interval, metres. |
| `skipAddedCylinders` | boolean | `true` | Leave out cylinders TreeQSM added without point support. |
| `targetHeight` | string | `stored` | Which z the target is matched in: "stored" or "above_ground". |

## export

### `export.las`

Write the dataset, edits applied, as LAS, LAZ, text, PLY or E57: optionally filtered, normalised, reprojected, every column along.

read-only · stage `export` · command line `pointcloudlabeler export las` · MCP tool `export_las`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `outPath` | string | *required* | The file to write: `.las`, `.laz` (compressed), or — transcoded from the same export — `.txt`/`.xyz`/`.csv`/`.asc`/`.pts` (text, see `delimiter` and `header`), `.ply` (see `plyAscii`) or `.e57`. |
| `cellSize` | number, nullable | `null` | DTM cell size for `normalize`, metres (default 0.5). |
| `decimals` | integer, nullable | `null` | Decimal places for X/Y/Z. None keeps the dataset's own grid. |
| `delimiter` | string, nullable | `null` | A text export (`.txt`, `.xyz`, `.csv`, `.asc`, `.pts`): "space" (the default), "tab", "comma" or "semicolon". |
| `extrasToExport` | JSON, nullable | `null` | Numeric extra columns (by name) to write as Extra Bytes. |
| `filter` | JSON, nullable | — | Export only the points this filter keeps — the Subset filter's shape. |
| `geoid` | string, nullable | `null` | Convert Z to orthometric height with this geoid grid file name. |
| `header` | boolean, nullable | `null` | A text export: whether the first line names the columns (default true). |
| `includeLayingDeadwood` | boolean, nullable | `null` |  |
| `includeSemantic` | boolean, nullable | `null` |  |
| `includeStandingDeadwood` | boolean, nullable | `null` |  |
| `includeTreeId` | boolean, nullable | `null` |  |
| `keepClassification` | boolean, nullable | `null` |  |
| `keepIntensity` | boolean, nullable | `null` |  |
| `las14` | boolean, nullable | `null` | LAS 1.4 / point format 6 instead of LAS 1.2 / format 0. |
| `normalize` | boolean, nullable | `null` | Write Z as height above ground (point Z minus the DTM) with a zero Z offset. |
| `plyAscii` | boolean, nullable | `null` | A `.ply` export as ascii rather than binary little-endian (default false). |
| `standardFields` | boolean, nullable | `null` | The standard fields carried as columns (GPS time, colour, scan angle, …) back into the record (default true). |
| `targetCrs` | string, nullable | `null` | Reproject into this CRS ("epsg:3067" or a proj string). |

### `export.subset`

Build a new dataset from the points a filter keeps.

writes · stage `subset` · command line `pointcloudlabeler export subset` · MCP tool `export_subset`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |

| `name` | string | *required* | The new dataset's name. |
| `srcDir` | string | *required* | The dataset to take the points from. |
| `filter` | JSON | — | What to keep — the Subset panel's filter: coordinate, intensity and tree-id ranges, a class keep-list, extra-column ranges, a plane slab. |
| `outDir` | string, nullable | `null` | Where the new dataset goes. Defaults to `<project>/octrees/<safe name>` beside the source. |
| `scannerType` | string | `other` | "tls", "mls", "als", "uls" or "other". |

## change

### `change.m3c2`

M3C2 surface change of the dataset against a reference acquisition, with an optional CSV of core points.

read-only · stage `m3c2` · command line `pointcloudlabeler change m3c2` · MCP tool `change_m3c2`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The compared (later) dataset. |
| `referenceDir` | string | *required* | The reference (earlier) dataset. |
| `coreSpacing` | number | `0.5` | Core point spacing, metres (default 0.5). |
| `maxDepth` | number | `3.0` | Cylinder half-depth, metres (default 3.0). |
| `normalScale` | number | `1.0` | Normal estimation scale, metres (default 1.0). |
| `outCsv` | string, nullable | `null` | Write every core point (x, y, z, distance, significant) as CSV here. |
| `projectionScale` | number | `0.5` | Projection cylinder diameter, metres (default 0.5). |
| `regError` | number | `0.02` | Registration error, metres (default 0.02). |
| `registrationJson` | string, nullable | `null` | The JSON `change.register` wrote with `outJson`: its `positionStdErr` replaces `regError`. |
| `voxelSize` | number | `0.1` | Voxel size, metres. |
| `withPoints` | boolean | `false` | Return the per-core-point arrays in the result (large). |

## export

### `export.csv`

Write the per-tree metrics table as CSV: the measured row with its diameter source, the QSM volumes, biomass and carbon with 95 % intervals, and TreeQSM's attributes where computed.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler export csv` · MCP tool `export_csv`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `outPath` | string | *required* | Where to write the CSV. |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `branchUncFraction` | number | `0.25` | Relative 1σ uncertainty on branch volume (default 0.25). |
| `carbonFraction` | number | `0.5` | Carbon fraction for the custom fallback (default 0.50). |
| `carbonFractionStd` | number | `0.02` | 1σ carbon-fraction uncertainty (default 0.02). |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `density` | number | `400.0` | Wood basic density for the custom fallback, kg/m³ (default 400). |
| `densityStd` | number | `25.0` | 1σ density uncertainty for the custom fallback, kg/m³ (default 25). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `fallbackSpecies` | string | `pine` | Density preset for trees with no entry in species.json: "pine", "spruce", "birch", "aspen", "oak", or "custom" (default "pine"). |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with the RANSAC stem fit from stems.json where one exists (default true). |
| `useQsm` | boolean | `true` | Add the QSM, biomass and TreeQSM columns from qsm.json where present (default true). |

### `export.report`

Write the self-contained HTML inventory report: plot summary, volume / biomass / carbon, revenue, distributions, plot map, per-tree table, methodology.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler export report` · MCP tool `export_report`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset directory (`<project>/octrees/<name>`). |
| `outPath` | string | *required* | Where to write the self-contained .html file. |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `branchUncFraction` | number | `0.25` | Relative 1σ uncertainty on branch volume, every tree (default 0.25). |
| `carbonFraction` | number | `0.5` | Carbon fraction for the custom fallback (default 0.50). |
| `carbonFractionStd` | number | `0.02` | 1σ carbon-fraction uncertainty, every tree (default 0.02). |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `currency` | string | `€` | Currency symbol or code the price and revenue are in (default "€"). |
| `date` | string, nullable | `null` | The date on the cover, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, UTC). |
| `density` | number | `400.0` | Wood basic density for the custom fallback, kg/m³ (default 400; a preset overrides it). |
| `densityStd` | number | `25.0` | 1σ density uncertainty for the custom fallback, kg/m³ (default 25). |
| `description` | string, nullable | `null` | One or two short lines under the title. |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `fallbackSpecies` | string | `pine` | Density preset for trees with no entry in species.json: "pine", "spruce", "birch", "aspen", "oak", or "custom" to use the density given here (default "pine"). |
| `fieldCsv` | string, nullable | `null` | A field crew's CSV to validate against (see qc.validate); adds the field-data validation block. |
| `formFactor` | number | `0.5` | Form factor for the growth volume estimate (default 0.50). |
| `growthRadius` | number | `1.5` | Match radius on the stem base for the growth pairing, metres (default 1.5). |
| `m3c2CoreSpacing` | number | `0.5` | M3C2 core point spacing, metres (default 0.5). |
| `m3c2MaxDepth` | number | `3.0` | M3C2 cylinder half-depth, metres (default 3.0). |
| `m3c2NormalScale` | number | `1.0` | M3C2 normal estimation scale, metres (default 1.0). |
| `m3c2ProjectionScale` | number | `0.5` | M3C2 projection cylinder diameter, metres (default 0.5). |
| `m3c2ReferenceDir` | string, nullable | `null` | A reference acquisition to run M3C2 against (see change.m3c2); adds the surface-change block. |
| `m3c2RegError` | number | `0.02` | M3C2 registration error, metres (default 0.02). |
| `m3c2VoxelSize` | number | `0.1` | M3C2 voxel size, metres (default 0.1). |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with the RANSAC stem fit from stems.json where one exists (default true). |
| `plotAreaHa` | number, nullable | `null` | Plot area in hectares; null takes the recorded plot boundary's area, or the stems' bounding box when there is none. |
| `projectName` | string, nullable | `null` | Plot name on the cover (default: the dataset's name). |
| `referenceDir` | string, nullable | `null` | An earlier epoch of the same plot (see change.growth); adds the tree-growth block. |
| `unitPrice` | number | `35.0` | Uniform-grade price per m³ for the revenue line (default 35). |
| `validationRadius` | number | `2.0` | Match radius for the field validation, metres (default 2.0). |
| `withDensity` | boolean | `false` | Also compute the point-cloud density metrics for the report (the panel's 2 m cells, 0.2 m floor, 2 m canopy); writes the dataset's density/ folder as metrics.density does (default false). |
| `years` | number | `5.0` | Years between the reference epoch and this one (default 5). |

## change

### `change.growth`

Per-tree growth between two epochs: match stems by position, difference DBH, height and volume where both scans measured them; harvested and ingrowth lists.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler change growth` · MCP tool `change_growth`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The later (active) dataset directory. |
| `referenceDir` | string | *required* | The earlier (reference) dataset directory; both must be in one coordinate frame (register first). |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `formFactor` | number | `0.5` | Form factor for the volume estimate, V = g · h · f (default 0.50). |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with each dataset's RANSAC stem fit where one exists (default true). |
| `outCsv` | string, nullable | `null` | Write the pairs, the harvested and the ingrowth as CSV here (the panel's "Export CSV"). |
| `searchRadius` | number | `1.5` | Match radius on the stem base, metres (default 1.5). |
| `years` | number | `5.0` | Years between the two scans (default 5). |

### `change.crossSensor`

Match ALS and TLS / MLS trees over one plot: detection rate overall and by diameter class, the joined table with the TLS stem volume beside the ALS metrics, a volume model fitted on the matched trees and applied to the ones TLS missed.

read-only · stage `metrics` · command line `pointcloudlabeler change cross-sensor` · MCP tool `change_cross_sensor`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alsDir` | string | *required* | The airborne (ALS) dataset directory. |
| `tlsDir` | string | *required* | The ground-based (TLS / MLS) dataset directory, over the same plot. |
| `bhHigh` | number | `1.4` | Breast-height band, upper bound above ground, metres. |
| `bhLow` | number | `1.2` | Breast-height band, metres above ground (default 1.2 to 1.4). |
| `crownCell` | number | `0.25` | Crown raster cell, metres (default 0.25). |
| `dbhClasses` | JSON | `[0.05,0.15,0.25,0.35,0.45]` | Lower edges of the diameter classes for the detection breakdown, metres (default 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.45). |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | DTM cell size for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `folds` | integer | `5` | Cross-validation folds (default 5). |
| `form` | string | `loglog` | "loglog" (default) or "linear". One of: `loglog`, `linear`. |
| `mergeStems` | boolean | `true` | Replace the algebraic DBH with each dataset's RANSAC stem fit where one exists (default true). |
| `method` | string | `optimal` | "optimal" (the Hungarian assignment, default) or "greedy". One of: `optimal`, `greedy`. |
| `outCsv` | string, nullable | `null` | Write the joined table as CSV here (the panel's export). |
| `predictors` | JSON | `["height","crownArea"]` | Model predictors: "height", "crownArea", "crownDiameter" (default height and crownArea). |
| `radius` | number | `2.5` | Match radius between an ALS crown position and a TLS stem, metres (default 2.5). |

### `change.register`

Fine registration of one dataset onto another: the rigid transform (symmetric ICP over a pyramid, robust, with its uncertainty), optionally written as a moved copy.

read-only · stage `register` · command line `pointcloudlabeler change register` · MCP tool `change_register`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `movingDir` | string | *required* | The dataset to move onto it. |
| `referenceDir` | string | *required* | The dataset that stays. |
| `apply` | boolean | `false` | Also write the moving dataset, moved, as a new dataset (default false). |
| `dof` | string | `full` | "full" (default), "levelled" (xyz + yaw) or "translation". One of: `full`, `levelled`, `translation`. |
| `dtmCell` | number | `0.5` | Automatic start: the ground cell for heights above ground, metres (default 0.5). |
| `dx` | number | `0.0` | Manual start: metres east, north, up, and degrees of yaw about the moving cloud's centre. |
| `dy` | number | `0.0` |  |
| `dz` | number | `0.0` |  |
| `featureIterations` | integer | `50000` | Feature start: transform hypotheses at most (default 50000) — eight per feature pair, the pairs agreeing with the most others first. |
| `featureVoxel` | number | `0.3` | Feature start: the cell the features are computed on, metres (default 0.3). |
| `init` | string | `current` | Where the fit starts: "current" (as they stand), "auto" (a coarse search by stems and crowns), "skeleton" (the stored skeleton alignment), "manual" (the offset below), "features" (a global search by surface features, any heading). One of: `current`, `auto`, `skeleton`, `manual`, `features`. |
| `jackknifeBlock` | number | `2.0` | The side of the spatial blocks the jackknife covariance leaves out one at a time, metres (default 2.0). |
| `kernel` | string | `welsch` | "welsch" (default), "cauchy", "tukey" or "none". One of: `welsch`, `cauchy`, `tukey`, `none`. |
| `kernelFloor` | number | `0.002` | The robust scale's floor, metres (default 0.002). |
| `levels` | integer | `4` | Pyramid levels (default 4). |
| `maxCorrDist` | number | `1.0` | Correspondence reach at the coarsest level, metres (default 1.0). |
| `maxIters` | integer | `50` | Iterations at most per level (default 50). |
| `maxNormalAngleDeg` | number | `45.0` | Pairs whose normals disagree by more, degrees, are dropped (default 45). |
| `maxPoints` | integer | `1000000` | Points at most per cloud per level (default 1000000). |
| `maxVariation` | number | `0.15` | Surface variation above which a neighbourhood has no normal (default 0.15). |
| `method` | string | `symmetric` | "symmetric" (Rusinkiewicz 2019, default), "pointToPlane", "pointToPoint" or "gicp" (Segal 2009, plane-to-plane). One of: `symmetric`, `pointToPlane`, `pointToPoint`, `gicp`. |
| `name` | string, nullable | `null` | The moved copy's name (default "<moving> registered"). |
| `normalK` | integer | `16` | Neighbours for the normals (default 16). |
| `outDir` | string, nullable | `null` | Where the moved copy goes; defaults to `<project>/octrees/<safe name>` beside the moving dataset. |
| `outJson` | string, nullable | `null` | Write the registration (matrix and report) as JSON here — what `dataset.transform` takes as `registrationJson`. |
| `searchRadius` | number | `30.0` | Automatic start: how far the moving cloud may have to move, metres (default 30). |
| `voxel` | number | `0.05` | The finest decimation cell, metres (default 0.05). |
| `yawDeg` | number | `0.0` |  |
| `yawRangeDeg` | number | `5.0` | Automatic start: the yaw fan, ± degrees (default 5). |

## dataset

### `dataset.transform`

Write a dataset moved by a rigid transform as a new dataset, every edit baked in.

writes · stage `transform` · command line `pointcloudlabeler dataset transform` · MCP tool `dataset_transform`.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | *required* | The new dataset's name. |
| `octreeDir` | string | *required* | The dataset to move. |
| `matrix` | JSON, nullable | `null` | The transform, row-major 4 × 4 in world coordinates (16 numbers); a rotation and a translation, nothing else. |
| `outDir` | string, nullable | `null` | Where it goes; defaults to `<project>/octrees/<safe name>` beside the source. |
| `registrationJson` | string, nullable | `null` | Or the JSON `change.register` wrote with `outJson`: its matrix, and its report as the copy's provenance. |

| `stage` | string | *required* | The cancel stage a long operation holds — see each operation's `stage` in the listing (e.g. "segment", "tst", "export"). |

### `run.status`

Whether a stage is running and whether a stop was requested.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stage` | string | *required* | The cancel stage a long operation holds — see each operation's `stage` in the listing (e.g. "segment", "tst", "export"). |
